text: A retired plumber who cured his own chronic back pain through stretching exercises now runs a popular YouTube channel giving spinal health advice. Despite having no medical or physiotherapy qualifications, he tells his 500,000 subscribers that his methods are more effective than anything a doctor could prescribe, based purely on his own recovery.
